items.name: notched service blade
items.description: A practical one-handed blade with a wrapped grip and a notch near the guard. It has been repaired more often than it has been polished.

items.name: layered field coat
items.description: Overlapping cloth-and-resin panels reinforce this weather-dark coat without making it rigid.

items.name: dull transit token
items.description: The stamped route number has been worn smooth by many nervous thumbs.

items.name: blank amber credit chip
items.description: A thumb-sized amber wafer bears a worn value grid but no current balance mark. A salvage tally has been penciled along one edge.

items.name: blue-black glass splinter
items.description: Blue light seems to retreat through the black glass whenever you bring it close to your eye.

items.name: short scavenged maul
items.description: A cut-down maintenance hammer has been rebound as a brutal close weapon.

items.name: sealed patch kit
items.description: A palm-sized trauma kit bears a green recovery stripe. Its seal is intact.

items.name: blunt calibration knife
items.description: A narrow polymer training edge carries bright alignment marks and a deliberately rounded point.

items.name: weighted test rig
items.description: Overlapping composite blocks make this diagnostic harness intentionally cumbersome while distributing impacts across the torso.

items.name: sealed composite repair strip
items.description: Layered resin cloth and flexible splints sit inside a numbered weather seal, sized for field armor panels.

items.name: sealed clinic medicine case
items.description: A white cold-case holds numbered vials behind a failing thermal lattice. Fresh gray paint covers most of an older orange clinic seal.

items.name: sealed protection ledger
items.description: Waterproof tally strips sit inside a cracked route-map sleeve. Dates, barter values, clinic marks, and a faded Faux Forsaken glyph turn ordinary debts into a map of who controls each block.

items.name: burned Collector checksum sliver
items.description: A heat-curled diagnostic strip preserves two reconstruction timestamps. One predates Sol's claimed discovery of the Recall/Collector by three days.

items.name: pre-intake subject marker
items.description: A rainproof optical tag carries your reconstruction signature, a class-shaped response profile, and a routing time stamped before your awakening. The reverse is marked SUBJECT INTAKE—OBSERVE, NOT RECOVER.

items.name: adaptive field-repair weave
items.description: A folded sheet of resin-thread mesh tightens when warmed and bonds to field-composite armor without a powered shop. The watcher rig carried it as post-trial recovery stock.

items.name: field modification kit
items.description: A compact set of composite shims, bond wire, and diagnostic tabs designed to improve one stable weapon or armor frame at a fitted bench.

items.name: Clave’s signal shard
items.description: A dark sliver of hardened relay glass bearing a route signature Clave says will be recognized beyond Sprawl 15. It is an introduction, not an oath.

items.name: provisional transit seal
items.description: A neutral transit seal keyed to one faction-facing route. It grants passage to a contact point but carries no rank, reputation, or membership.

items.name: clean scrap alloy
items.description: Sorted structural alloy suitable for repair plates and field fabrication.

items.name: conductive filament coil
items.description: A clean coil used for circuitry, sensors, and controlled repair work.

items.name: sealed medical gel
items.description: A licensed wound gel that can become a patch kit or clinic seal.

items.name: insulating route cloth
items.description: Layered cloth that protects skin and circuits from heat, cold, and static.

items.name: sealed source-dust vial
items.description: A tiny vial of meteor-derived dust, useful and dangerous enough to stay sealed.

items.name: sealed route rations
items.description: Compact food and clean water intended for one dangerous regional leg.

items.name: salvaged circuit lattice
items.description: A stable lattice used in modification kits, filters, and signal work.

items.name: Avalonte frost lining
items.description: A removable liner that reduces the first severe cold exposure on an expedition.

items.name: Dark Water filter mask
items.description: A compact filter that reduces the first toxic spray exposure near ruined water cities.

items.name: Crater ash wrap
items.description: A heat-resistant face and neck wrap for the Crater’s mixed ash and meteor winds.

items.name: licensed clinic seal
items.description: A carefully fabricated cold-chain seal carrying Mara’s clinic tally mark.

items.name: portable signal spike
items.description: A short-range signal anchor for moving names and warnings without exposing a fixed relay.

items.name: route armor plate
items.description: A removable plate that can reinforce field clothing or be sold for clean alloy.

items.name: Avalonte relic fragment
items.description: An ancient scored fragment recovered from a frozen shelf; its purpose remains unresolved.

items.name: drowned-city transit map
items.description: A water-damaged map of streets that now lie beneath Dark Water.

items.name: five-point sensory anchor band
items.description: A soft field band with five ordinary haptic markers for sightline, sound, touch, balance, and self-orientation. It is a game-adaptation recovery tool, not one of the canonical seven gates and not proof of limiter mechanics.

items.name: phase-discipline practice plate
items.description: A deliberately scuffed composite plate used to test repair, crafting, support, control, reporting, and attack disciplines without risking a person. It contains no identity, memory, or canonical alternate self.
